criteria.evidence: 19 content_* baselines exist; opened progress_40, progress_font200, resume_paper, filecard: match prototype intent (check/spinner/pending rows, wrapped labels at 2.0 with no ellipsis, paper with lime/amber highlights and 92% badge, file card with 48dp Share/Open pills).

TmrProgressRowStyleTest covers colours (pending textDisabled per D32) and tmrSpinnerAngle static when reduced; TmrProgressRowsTest covers semantics and 2.0 bounds. No composable-level test that the spinner does not animate under reduced motion.
TmrPaperColourTest and TmrResumePaperTest assert highlight colours, single merged summary 'Keywords matched: 92%', no 'match' word, legend entries.
TmrFileCardTest asserts both buttons >=48dp, Role.Button, descriptions, callbacks fire once each.
Reviewed files use only Keywords matched wording; progress row sample labels in tests are test data only.

findings.trigger: ProgressSpinner ignores LocalTmrMotion.reduced and starts rememberInfiniteTransition: reducedMotionStillRenders still passes because it only asserts text exists; only the pure tmrSpinnerAngle helper is tested, which the composable bypasses on the reduced path.
findings.title: Reduced-motion test cannot fail if the spinner animates
findings.proof: Under Reduced, setContent with mainClock.autoAdvance=false, advance 450ms, and assert the spinner node rotation/bitmap is unchanged (or that no infinite transition is registered).

findings.rule: D40 no ellipsis, no mid-word break
findings.trigger: assertStaysInsideContainer checks only left/right bounds at 337dp/2.0; a label ellipsized or broken mid-word still passes. Text has no maxLines in the changed files, so current code is fine, but the guard is weak.
findings.title: Font-scale test does not assert D40 wrapping

findings.trigger: Paper text uses fixedSp at 7 to 8.5dp so it does not scale with font 2.0 and is below normal legibility; semantics expose only the summary so a screen reader user gets no resume text.
findings.title: Paper body text is fixed tiny size and hidden from semantics
